notes.title: Arcadian Days pre-release post
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am beyond excited + a little nervous to finally release Arcadian days in Early Access! We have build quite a number of wishlists without much, if any, marketing budget, and almost the entire game has been solo made by me, with some amazing support from freelancers for some models and gameplay elements. We have a new trailer available I hope you enjoy, it doesn't reveal much as Arcadian Days is a game full of secrets and discoveries that I want players to find. I will however try to answer now some questions for you : 


What is the actual loop of Arcadian Days? Is it a farming sim?

Arcadian Days is an adventure and exploration game that is highly quest and character driven. You will spend your time exploring, completing quests and making discoveries, each aimed to be designed to be interesting, unique and most importantly related to each other. Every quest and element in Arcadian Days will influence other elements in some way or another.

It is not a farming sim or a crafting game, and those are elements that will probably not be introduced as I want the narrative and discovery to be the main focus as well as allow the game to stand on its own amongst a sea of cozy crafting and farming sims! 

I hope the story we are crafting for you will be enjoyable and you will greatly enjoy discovering this world, completing the quests and watching how your actions influence the narrative and the world. 

As we release more updates, there will be more to come to expand the story in some very interesting ways. however for the initial run of Early Access we will focus on getting to know the characters and the world of Arcadian Days. 


How long will the game be in its current state?
The aim is for Arcadian Days to be an open world adventure game that respects your time, with diverse and well thought out quests, with a lot of replayability as the branching storyline expands. The current state of Early Access can be anywhere between 3 to 6 hours depending on how quick one moves and wanting to discover everything, with much more quests and content to come regularly.




What is the roadmap for Arcadian Days? 
I will reveal a proper roadmap very shortly after release as I analyze the data, however rest assured there is currently a VERY clear roadmap ahead and all major updates have already been planned. Depending on the success of Early Access and community engagement, I want to hire more people full time to assist in developing this world. 

I am excited to reveal a big update will already come next week that will add even more quests and adventures as well as a quest chain related to the fuzzy sheep of Bucuria. As i have been quite ill the past month it was hard to prepare all the quests but they are coming very shortly and I hope regularly. 

Things to look forward to in future updates include :



An expanded storyline that aims to be wholesome, hearth-warming and have a touch of mystery and supernatural. Lots of diverse and fun side quests and activities as well!


Expanded customisation of the household and characters, with players having a more direct role in the way the homestead can be customised as well as what the characters wear, all of course quest related in fun ways!

Tola the dog companion, who will be with you and help you with quests and also have interactions. The aim is to have one of the best dog companions in a game every, where Tola is not just an extension of the main character but its own being for players to connect with and grow. 

More environments to explore which aim to be unique and never seen before including a river Delta, a majestic valley unlike any other and an ancient fortress on top of a forested hill. 

Some new NPCs, new ways to interact with your family and a late game storyline where the player will choose the vocation the Dragobete family will follow, whether they wish to focus on animal husbandry, textiles or even fishing!

The Mocanitza - Can't say much about this one yet but I will leave a clue : 🚂

Community requests and features, I can't wait to hear your ideas and see what we can implement!

Localization and Steam Achievements !


Can we expect a lot of bugs and performance issues?
Hopefully you shouldn't even for an Early Access game! A lot of time has been spent to ensure there are no game breaking bugs, there might be a few glitches and placeholders here and there which please do let us know so we can fix asap! 
I know Unreal Engine 5 has quite a reputation but I tried really hard to ensure it is as well optimised as possible, however I haven't had a chance to test on lower end computers, so please do let us know how the game runs for you and your specs, the optimisation of the game will be a constant work and I want to ensure the game runs very very well.





If you have any more questions, please do let me know, and feel free to join our discord using the links below as well as following our socials. Please do use the community features for any bugs, performance issues or just general questions, I will follow those closely and look forward to connecting with you all. 

I can't wait to meet you all in Bucuria and continue on this journey, I appreciate all your support so far!

- Cal, Game Developer of Arcadian Days

notes.title: Arcadian Days release date - 16.09.2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 



Super excited to share that Arcadian Days is releasing in Early Access on 16 of September 2025!



Watch our new trailer below.
[previewyoutube="Nk1ZH4x6RY8;full"][/previewyoutube]
 Arcadian Days has had a long journey and still quite a bit ahead, here's what you can expect when Chapter 1 : Bucuria Awaits releases!

Up to 6 hours of playtime featuring Act 1 of the main story as well as over a dozen of side quests and unique activities, with dynamic events

3 Massive and Diverse open world maps for you to get lost in.

Non-linear and player driven gameplay and discovery - your hand will not be held except by your parents in the game of course ! Discover at your own pace and be surprised by the depth of the world.

AAA-level graphics and presentation, beautifully rendered and optimized.

And plenty more I do not wish to spoil at this time!

Arcadian Days has been the work of a solo dev so far and the aim is to deliver a wholesome and relaxing experience, you can expect more news to come and maybe even a few dev logs if time allows, please do share with your friends if Arcadian Days seems like something they would enjoy. 

Looking forward to seeing you all in Bucuria in September!

  - Cal, Game Director

notes.title: Arcadian Days Steam Next Fest Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Unfortunately I couldn't quite release as big of an update for Steam Next Fest as I wished as I was very inconveniently hit by a bad case of the Flu, however I still have plenty for you :) 



Performance should be massively improved across lots of devices + Steam Deck playability.

Small dialogue tree for the parents that can help guide you towards events and interesting things in the explorable zone. 

Tutorials added in the journal that will explain some of the concepts such as building and collecting resources. 

Ending to the demo is now available when you reach Zuzuiata Hills. 

The corn field can be explored and features its own challenges in finding the corn basket! 

Bug fixes, particularly revolving around the UI. 



There will be even more updates coming throughout the week as I catch up to my work, however I hope you are enjoying the demo so far and as always please leave your feedback regarding performance, bugs and features in general via the Arcadian Days forum or by joining our Discord! It would also mean the world if you enjoy the Demo and recommend it to your friends to play. 



Looking forward to continuing to share more from the world of Arcadian Days!

- Cal, Game Developer of Arcadian Days

notes.title: Arcadian Days - Smooth Butter Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Thank you all for the feedback on the demo so far, particularly regarding performance! You will also notice a slightly smaller disk size.

Having done some under the hood work, I am hoping this new update will significantly improve performance for you! You should now be able to play most of the demo at a steady 60 FPS even on Very High settings, however I have seen that the game looks just as gorgeous on High, so make sure to choose the option that suits you best! 

The Zuzuiata Hills section still sees some drops particularly near the Sheep and the campfire but should still maintain a framerate close to 60 FPS without noticeable drops, however as it is the main open map the performance will be consistently looked into to improve. 

I am very grateful to you all for letting me know about your performance woes and it is very important for me that Arcadian Days can be enjoyed by as many of you as possible. 

As always, please let me know how the performance is and any feedback. 

I look forward to sharing with you all the content update for Steam Next Fest! 

- Cal, Developer of Arcadian Days

notes.title: Arcadian Days Demo - Little Steps Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

I am overwhelmed by the love for the Arcadian Days Demo so far, we have had lots of players already starting to explore Bucuria! 

A big content patch will come on the 8th just in time for Steam Next Fest, but until then we have released a small patch that should : 

- Improve performance 
- Fix the visual glitch where Miela's hair was in the wrong place in a cutscene. 
- Added additional foliage and decorations of the house. 
- Fix some issues where the game wouldn't transition when interacting with the cart. 

I am currently aware that the FPS limit setting and mouse sensitivity isn't working properly, actively looking into it.

Please do leave your feedback or report bugs by joining our discord, dropping a message on the forums or emailing at calin@immersivgames.com

Arcadian Days is a mostly solo effort but I aim to deliver a polished and wholesome experience for all! 

- Cal, Game Director of Arcadian Days
